Privacy Policy

Last Updated: March 24, 2026

Welcome to ResumeAI Pro. Your privacy is critically important to us. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our mobile application.

1. Information We Collect

We collect information to provide better services to our users. This includes:

  • Account Information: Your name and email address when you sign in via Google, Apple, or Email.
  • Profile Data: Information you provide about your professional background, target job roles, and skills.
  • Resume Content: Any text or data you enter to build your resumes, including work history and education.
  • Job Tracker Data: Information about the jobs you are applying to, their status, and interview notes.

2. How We Use AI (Google Gemini)

ResumeAI Pro uses the Google Gemini API to generate resume content and analyze your resume for ATS optimization. To provide this service, the text you enter into the app is sent to Google's servers for processing. This data is used solely to generate your resume and is not used by ResumeAI Pro for any other purpose.

3. Payments and Subscriptions

We use RevenueCat to handle our subscription billing. We do not store or collect your credit card data. All payments are processed securely through the Apple App Store or Google Play Store.

4. Data Storage and Security

Your data is stored securely in our Supabase cloud database. We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

5. Your Data Rights

You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal data at any time through the app settings. If you delete your account, all your resumes and tracking data will be permanently removed from our servers.

6. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@parthdarji.com.
